description: User-friendly AI Interface, supports Ollama, OpenAI API.
license: Open WebUI License (BSD-3-Clause with a branding clause)

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Open WebUI 0.11.3, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from Runtipi's app store.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Asks you to create an account on first open; the first account is the administrator.
Connects to an Ollama server at the address you give during setup, or to OpenAI with your key; other providers can be added in its settings.
Source-available under the Open WebUI License, BSD-3 with a clause that keeps its branding.
Its first start downloads a search model, which took longer than the usual allowance here; it is given ten minutes.

OPENWEBUI_OLLAMA_URL.label: Ollama server address, if you run one (optional)
